notice: Research inventory, not a cleared corpus. All production artifacts require exact version, hash and rights review.

sources.title: Paperclip adapter and agent configuration
sources.finding: Adapters bridge orchestration and runtimes; installed schemas and model support must be inspected. Agent budget/run policy varies by version.

sources.title: ESV publisher permissions
sources.finding: Copyrighted translation with specific quotation/digital terms; ordinary access does not grant the proposed open-corpus or AI translation workflow. Default exclusion; request explicit written scope if needed.

sources.title: ESV API terms
sources.finding: API imposes storage/display/redistribution limits and other conditions. A freely obtainable API is not an offline open-text license.

sources.title: World English Bible
sources.finding: Publisher identifies the text as public domain; preserve edition and text integrity. Changed text must not be represented as the unchanged World English Bible.

sources.title: STEPBible Data
sources.finding: Repository states CC BY 4.0 with attribution/change recording. Inspect each chosen file and its upstream dependencies; useful for tagged texts, lexical data and mappings.

sources.title: SBL Greek New Testament
sources.finding: Current upstream describes CC BY 4.0. Pin exact text edition; critical editorial choices are not interchangeable with other Greek editions.

sources.title: Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible
sources.finding: WLC underlying text is public domain; morphology/lemma layer is CC BY 4.0. Preserve upstream token IDs and normalization cautions.

sources.title: unfoldingWord source-language resources
sources.finding: UHB/UGNT and related grammars/lexicons are open-licensed candidates, generally CC BY-SA 4.0 on the referenced page. Check the exact work/version and trademark terms before adaptation.

sources.title: OpenBible cross references
sources.finding: Roughly 340,000 links, primarily derived from Treasury of Scripture Knowledge, with additional sources/votes. Page links a CC BY license; ESV quotations on the site are separate. Import reference links/attribution only after recording the exact linked license. Votes are not accuracy scores.

sources.title: Perseus canonical Greek literature
sources.finding: Repository default CC BY-SA 4.0 unless indicated otherwise, with varying object rights and unverified headers. Check each TEI edition/translation and preserve attribution.

sources.title: CCEL and Early Church Fathers
sources.finding: Ancient/patristic discovery source. Many underlying books are US public domain, but site content/editions and permission statements are mixed. Do not blanket-import; seek a clearly licensed artifact or separate public-domain transcription.

sources.title: CrossWire SWORD and module rights
sources.finding: Engine is GPL; each text module has its own rights. Distribution permission to CrossWire does not automatically authorize this project to redistribute everything.

sources.title: Tailscale network layers
sources.finding: WireGuard data transport is distinct from coordination/identity/relay behavior. Mesh access is not app authorization or anonymity.

sources.title: Headscale DERP self-hosting
sources.finding: Supports embedded/custom DERP; public-relay map exclusion must be explicit and connectivity tested. Self-hosting can create its own availability bottleneck.

sources.title: Keycloak OIDC
sources.finding: Reference for self-hosted OIDC and supported flows; use authorization code plus PKCE and carefully scoped redirects.

sources.title: SQLite browser and Expo storage
sources.finding: Browser VFS/worker support and cross-origin isolation requirements vary. Test chosen storage adapter and Safari rather than assuming native parity.

sources.title: W3C Web Annotation Data Model
sources.finding: TextQuote and TextPosition selectors provide useful interoperable anchor conventions; immutable edition context and reanchoring policy remain project requirements.

sources.title: MorphGNT SBLGNT
sources.finding: Morphological analysis uses CC BY-SA 3.0; README references an older SBLGNT EULA whereas current SBLGNT upstream is CC BY 4.0. Resolve edition/version provenance and layered obligations, not one blanket license.

sources.title: NixOS Android tooling
sources.finding: androidenv supports composing SDK inputs. Exact SDK/NDK/license/build configuration remains an implementation verification task.

sources.title: AndBible
sources.finding: GPL-3.0-or-later offline Android study app. Study panes, note/export and module workflows; no license-blind copying into differently licensed clients.

sources.title: Ezra Bible App
sources.finding: SWORD-based cross-platform topical study with a GPL-2.0 repository label. Inspect exact licensing before reuse; useful workflow inspiration for tags and notes.

sources.title: Calibre
sources.finding: Open-source ebook management/conversion reference. Useful for library ownership/export concepts; dependency and copied-code licenses require separate review.

sources.title: OpenAI ChatGPT plan usage for OSS
sources.finding: Official optional authorization path for eligible open-source/locally hosted apps; platform and deployment conditions require verification.

sources.title: Codex app-server plan usage
sources.finding: Documented app-server integration exists; catalog listing alone does not prove model entitlement.

sources.title: OpenAI plan-usage preview limitations
sources.finding: The preview has distinct request/tool/history restrictions; adapter conformance must be tested rather than assuming ordinary API parity.

sources.title: Obsidian Vault API
sources.finding: Vault API includes read and guarded process-style updates; use it for plugin file operations.

sources.title: Obsidian mobile development
sources.finding: Node/Electron APIs are unavailable on mobile; platform support must be explicit.

sources.title: Obsidian native block links
sources.finding: Native block IDs and #^ references target actual note blocks; materialized scripture can use the same mechanism.

sources.title: perfect-freehand
sources.finding: MIT stroke geometry library; it is not a complete handwritten-note editor.

sources.title: Excalidraw source and license
sources.finding: MIT editor candidate; validate the selected package, assets and platform behavior.

sources.title: tldraw licensing
sources.finding: Current SDK is source-available/commercially licensed; excluded from the fully open-source default.

sources.title: Claude Code product integration terms
sources.finding: Current terms describe conditional integration of unmodified Claude Code with end-user authentication; review exact deployment obligations.

sources.title: Claude Agent SDK authentication statement
sources.finding: SDK page still restricts third-party subscription login without approval; reconcile with the product-integration page before enabling the selected route.

sources.title: Claude Code headless mode
sources.finding: Programmatic mode exists; bare mode does not use subscription OAuth. Configuration isolation must be designed for the chosen auth mode.

sources.title: OpenAI self-hosted VM plan usage
sources.finding: Documented personal VM path has credential/host-ID/refresh and current revocation-attribution limitations; do not generalize to a shared commercial relay.

sources.title: Android Ink API
sources.finding: Official low-latency ink API candidate for a native adapter; verify exact library version/license and portable data conversion in the spike.
